statement: Prompt Code valid values are 901, 902, 903, 904, 905.
Prompt Code, Pending valid values are 0901, 0902, 0904, 0981.
Fields 14-20 are formatted as Custom Receipt Text Data when Prompt Code (Field 78) is 901.
Fields are not separated by Field Separators; unpopulated fields are immediately followed by the next field.
Fields of Field Nos. 14-27 are not separated by Field Separators; when a field is not populated, next field immediately follows.
Prompt Code field in Segment 119 has fixed value 990.
Fields in the Store and Forward Data Segment are not separated by Field Separators; unpopulated fields are immediately followed by next field.
Element 116=016 includes PIN-on-Receipt information.
Any location generating more than 1,500 transactions per month must subscribe to dial backup.
Any location generating more than 500,000 transactions per month must have at least two diverse connections supporting automatic rerouting.
Sub-Table ID 05 Data '1' = Host Prompts supported, '0' = Host Prompts not supported.
Sub-Table Length is fixed at 001.
Only MCC '6051' is applicable to cryptocurrency purchase transactions.
Only MCC '6211' is applicable to high risk security transactions.
Merchants should include PAR request indicator if they opt to receive PAR data from the authorizer.
Additional Re-Price Type values may be added beyond those listed.
UCAF Security Level position 3 value 0 means UCAF data collection is not supported.
UCAF Security Level position 3 value 1 means data collection supported but UCAF data not populated.
UCAF Security Level position 3 value 2 means data collection supported and UCAF data is present.
Position 1-2 value 21 is preferred, meaning channel encryption without cardholder certificate.
UCAF field should only be used for MasterCard Accountholder Authentication Value (AAV).
Valid value 'Y' indicates DAF indicator acceptance flag.
Sub-Table ID 16 valid code is D for Delayed Card Sale.
Sub-Table Data (KSN) is required for AES DUKPT, TDES, and Ingenico OnGuard encryption types.
Sub-Table Data (Device Type) is required for AES DUKPT encryption type.
Sub-Table Data (Device Type) is optional for TDES and Ingenico OnGuard encryption types.
If Validation Flag is provided in initial transaction, it must be provided in all subsequent transactions with same value as initial or last Modification transaction.
First recurring registration and transaction for a cardholder in India requires additional factor authentication.
Subsequent recurring transactions do not require additional factor authentication.
If cardholder modifies or revokes a standing instruction, additional factor authentication is required.
Sub-table IDs 01 and 02 are mutually exclusive; merchant can send only one based on request type.
Merchant should send only the applicable indicator in the request message, based on type of request.
Sub-Table ID and Sub-Table Length valid values are 01-25.
Account Updater Request Indicator applicable only to Visa and MasterCard.
Service Location City Name must be present for all transactions when different from Acceptor City Name.
For U.S. region, Service Location City Name must match the U.S. Postal Service list of acceptable cities and spellings.
If an external payment gateway is involved, the corresponding merchant gateway ID has to be sent.
If Sub-Table 01 field is sent in Auth, it should also be sent in its completion.
Value "2" (Acquirer) expected when Sub-Table ID 02 contains "4" (Next Gen POI), "5" (Pay by Link), or "6" (X QR).
Value "0" (Multi-Domain) expected when Sub-Table ID 02 contains "0" (Multi-Program).
Sub-Table Length fixed value is 04 for Service Type sub-table.
Product Category/Description tag is optional for fuel transactions.
Additional Re-Price Type values may be added beyond those listed.
DAF Indicator valid values are 01 through 07 representing different authentication/data types.
Start Sentinel character is not displayed as part of Track data and is cut from the packet.
TransArmor Tokens cannot be used to initiate financial transactions.
When a device moves lanes or is new, it must be re-registered using the Registration Process.
Controller/customer-activated device should support encryption.
Controller/device should have a system console.
Value 0/1 indicates that either 0 or 1 is allowed for that bit.
Value 0/1 indicates that either 0 or 1 is allowed for that bit.
TACs may be adjusted based on terminal capabilities supported and approved by EMVCo.
Final total purchase amount cannot exceed the authorized amount in the completed CAT Authorization Only transaction.
Return and Refund Policies terms and conditions are mandatory on receipt.
Amount Authorized (9F02) is printed with a decimal point.
Tag 5F20 (Cardholder Name) must not be printed for Interac receipts
Amount Authorized (Tag 9F02) is printed with a decimal point
High Fallback rates may indicate need for training, possible fraud, or equipment malfunction.
Failure to provide EMV Configuration Report during certification may delay a project
Default TDOL (97) varies by Brand
TAC - Default varies by Project
TAC - Online varies by Project
Tag 9F53 is required for Mastercard Credit and optional for Mastercard Debit AID.
Tag 9F6E must be Upper Case for alpha values; consult Mastercard/Visa docs for valid Form Factor values; do not send if invalid.
Tag 9F0A is a new optional tag for Mastercard.
Updating Protected Data Envelopes with PUT DATA command requires secure messaging.
Mastercard only supports CDA as the Security Capability for contactless transactions.
Currency symbol must be included unless transaction is in local currency of transaction country.
Terminal should select highest priority unblocked application when multiple applications present; cardholder not prompted.
Fuelman cards expect terminals to perform Combined Data Authentication (CDA).
PPSE is mandatory in all contactless implementations.
Testing requires settlement and back-office testing to ensure no impact to proper transaction clearing.
Client must perform an error-free 'Clean Run' of each Brand's test transactions after issues addressed and waivers obtained.
If test cases fail and are not covered by waivers, process returns to Test Certify Phase to correct and rerun.
If validation fails, a discussion takes place between client, Fiserv, and t3:Cert platform.
New Terminal Deployment does not require extra certification for terminal families with an already certified member.
Partial Selection of AID must be supported, except for Union Pay AIDs due to unique extensions.
Final selection application names must be displayed to the cardholder only, not the clerk/cashier.
Candidate List Filter cannot isolate to a CAID, unlike Auto Select of CAID.
All Offline CAM failures must be sent for online authorization via TAC settings.
If any offline CVM is supported by the kernel, all three (SDA, DDA, CDA) must be supported.
CDA must be supported in a mode performing the CDA process; only CDA Mode 1 is permitted.
Returned Application Cryptogram is always same or more restrictive than requested; chip cannot return TC if ARQC requested.
A 19-digit PAN sent in a Dual Message may authorize but will not settle.
Application Cryptogram returned by card will always be same or more restrictive than requested.
DCC choice presented and chosen by cardholder prior to PIN entry and authentication.
Application List should NOT be presented to cardholder for selection in this scenario.
Mastercard Refund Authorization requires AAC for Contactless transactions (RQ 4701).
Completion transactions must follow the pre-authorization message per industry rules and regulations.
Referral transactions must be declined in 2nd Generate AC
Tag 9F36 (Application Transaction Counter/ATC) may be out of sequence for SAF transactions.
Fiserv strongly discourages offline approvals and recommends sending all transactions online for authorization.
If CAID is present it must be selected (Auto Select of Common AID).
Exponent value must equal '3' or '216+1' ("010001").
Application Identifier numbers printed on receipt are truncated.
